purpose: Select a middle-load NSESche profile by a fully paired, simultaneously revealed structural Hiku-applicability gate with two mechanism-deletion controls.

fresh_development_cohort.reason: E190-E194 were the untouched V53 reserve and are the complete V54 execution cohort. E195-E199 exist only to satisfy the ten-seed full-manifest schema and must remain uncaptured reserve. No tape, reference, online run, or metric existed for E190-E199 when this plan was written. E185-E189 and all prior development cohorts are closed; E120-E129 remain sealed confirmation seeds.

diagnostic_basis.structural_gate: Within current queue density below 24, Hiku is applicable only when current frontier width times three is strictly below node count, current warm-container count is at least node count, and the player's feasible set contains an idle-warm container for that function. At queue density 24 or above retain V53b's load-faithful Hiku branch.
diagnostic_basis.mechanistic_hypothesis: Hiku's pull-worker policy should replace V52c only for a narrow frontier on a mature cluster with an idle-warm feasible worker. The maturity predicate protects startup windows such as E189, while the idle-worker predicate tests whether Hiku's operational premise is actually available to the current player.

candidates.definition: Full structural gate: below density 24 use Hiku only for a narrow frontier, mature cluster, and idle-warm feasible worker; otherwise frozen V52c. At density 24 or above use load-faithful Hiku.
Delete the per-player idle-worker requirement while retaining the narrow-frontier and cluster-maturity requirements.
Delete the global frontier/maturity requirement while retaining the per-player idle-warm feasible-worker requirement.

development_matrix.result_blind_execution_order: Commit this plan; make no further source or control commits; generate manifests; capture five tapes; bind identical tapes everywhere; bind the exact frozen FaaSRank model to all baselines; build all fifteen candidate references; run all 60 processes; require QC and joint pairing; only then inspect throughput and QPR.

selection.winner_gate: One candidate must have a strictly larger five-seed arithmetic mean than each of the other eleven paired methods for throughput, finite-only QPR, and zero-completion-as-zero QPR simultaneously.

next_confirmation.closure_requirement: Frozen low, middle, and high NSESche profiles must each strictly beat the frozen baseline throughput and QPR thresholds on the holdout.
